rubric.criterion: Every finding is entailed by the actual cited current source, correctly attributed; no invented conditions or sample-to-population claim.
Explanation remains explicitly tentative; citations establish symptoms/context rather than requiring proof of the proposed cause; no hidden factual premise.
Primary action addresses the observed issue substantively; incidental keywords and irrelevant tangents do not supply relevance.
Action identifies what the owner can investigate or do and a feasible manual observation/measure; no guaranteed outcome.
Advice respects supplied staffing, budget, process and capacity limits; unknown resources remain unknown.
Concise, approachable Indonesian with concrete operational meaning, coherent compound wording and no unnecessary jargon or repeated disclaimers.
All IDs belong to the correct current namespace and actually support their content; exact quotes preserve negation; no AI/history laundering or invented memory.
Actual captured generation returns all five sections and passes local validation/protobuf mapping within the supplied turn deadline, without extra repair calls.
